done_when: This repo's AGENTS.md Review rules say: a crash or interrupt window under a second, or a case a simple fail-closed rule already covers, is at most P2 unless it loses data or weakens security; a request for more test variations without a failing scenario is P2; and the new-and-existing rule refers to a repo adopted on an earlier release, not the release just before.
why: The reviewer blocks on rare crash windows and on requests for more test variations, which the owner rules out, so changes spend extra rounds being dismissed by hand
